Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property & equipment (calculated). 10x Genomics reports a net loss, so per-share figures are losses.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: 10x Genomics' revenue rose 5.2% to $642.8M in 2025, but that includes $44.1M of one-time revenue from patent litigation settlements. Excluding it, revenue was $598.7M, down 2%. The operating loss narrowed to $61.0M from $194.6M, helped by lower spending and a $49.9M settlement gain.
Net loss narrowed to $43.5M, or $0.35 per share, from $182.6M. Operating cash flow jumped to $136.1M, and cash and marketable securities rose to $523.4M with no debt.
highlights: Consumables, the recurring part of the business, grew 2.8% to $507.2M, 79% of revenue.
Operating expenses before the settlement gain fell 8.9% as R&D and SG&A were cut.
Gross margin improved to 69.1% from 67.9%, and China revenue grew 22.6% to $70.3M.
watch: Instrument revenue fell 38.8% to $56.8M as labs held back on buying new systems.
Single cell consumables, the largest product line, slipped 2.4% to $363.2M.
Excluding settlements 2025 was a down year, and the 2026 outlook of $600M–$625M implies 0% to 4% growth.
Stock-based compensation of $108.8M (16.9% of revenue) was larger than the operating loss.
